periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented diagonally downwards and outwards at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Highly elongated oval morphology with a width-to-height ratio approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible tapering and extension towards the lower-outer corners, shifting the visual mass away from the medial axis.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape profile with minimal curvature along the posterior boundary visible across the shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness extending down the lateral flanks, occupying nearly 40% of the visible vertical torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded convex curvature at the ear apices with no observable flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown chromatic shift in the ventral and lower torso fur compared to the high-luminance white fur on the cranium.
